title: Inspired by the show
notes: The game is now inspired by Nashville rather than presented like a TV show. Every feature and every big moment from the story stays.
Seasons and episodes are now chapters and weeks of your life. 'Previously on Nashville' is now Highlights, 'Next time' is Coming up, and talking to camera is now your inner thoughts.

TV-only extras are gone: ratings, the cancellation and network move, season trailers, opening titles, cold opens and finale cliffhangers. The writers' room is now your own priorities for the year, and special episodes are now special weeks.
